title: An operation whole predicts a near result field
summary: Quantify whether a candidate operation whole is followed by a result or state field within the next two complete fields, rather than being a generic carrier. The bound is prospective and keeps operation, material, and terminal rivals separate.

design.mechanism: An operation licenses a short result latency in the local record.
design.unit: candidate occurrence and following two complete fields
design.contrast: candidate operation wholes versus matched material and terminal controls
design.prediction: At least 75% of held candidate occurrences have an independently tagged result/state within two fields, with a >=15-point excess over controls.
design.scope: cached complete fields; feasibility unknown until result tags are independently bound on five physical folios
design.countermodel: Apparent result proximity is record-length or section layout; latency excess disappears after matching.
design.binding: independent action/result annotations and held folio split
design.related: GDT702 immediate-right context; GDT625 state paths; this freezes a latency quantity
